answer: Each seat banks a genotype at enrolment; the ledger stores only the haplotype hash. Labs photograph every sample against a shale tile beside an ivory scale card, so a stock image or a copied file fails. Every epoch the challenge embeds a nonce derived from that hash, and any two seats sharing a genotype, a co-answer pattern or one submission subnet merge into a single vote, the cluster forfeiting a 60,000 POA bond. Panels run $85 a sample, so a thousand puppets owe $85,000 before one attestation lands. A raven on a fence post looks like any other bird until the genotype names its nest.
